entry.title: Meta brings its Muse AI assistant directly into Instagram DMs
entry.summary: The new integration gets rid of the need for users to toggle between Instagram and the Muse app when they want to interact with the AI agent.

entry.title: UK warns AI-driven cyberattacks are exposing years of weak security
entry.summary: The British cyber agency says that "building strong foundations has never mattered more" as AI hacking tools rely on exploiting simple security flaws.

entry.title: Anthropic shares fall below IPO price, a worrying sign for AI startups
entry.summary: Anthropic’s post-IPO slump could put pressure on AI startup valuations.

entry.title: Maple raises $5.3M to build AI products that protect your data, even from itself
entry.summary: The startup's encrypted AI architecture is designed to prevent even the company itself from accessing users' private data.

entry.title: Walmart teams up with Meta to bring Black Friday deals to AI agent Muse
entry.summary: Walmart now lets customers shop Black Friday deals through Muse, Meta’s AI agent.

entry.title: Even the best AI agents struggle with everyday life
entry.summary: As millions embrace personal AI assistants, a new benchmark reveals that even the most advanced AI models struggle to complete everyday tasks reliably and safely without introducing potential new problems.

entry.title: In all-hands meeting, Jensen Huang thanks White House and says he’s in therapy
entry.summary: The Nvidia founder apologized to his staff on Tuesday and said he was grateful for a second chance to lead the company.

entry.title: Jensen Huang still thinks a succession plan creates unnecessary hierarchy
entry.summary: It's a remarkable stance for a company that spent the last two weeks finding out what happens without its founder.

entry.title: Yale’s Sonnenfeld: Nvidia is a ‘detriment’ to US industrial might — not a champion
entry.summary: Yale's Jeffrey Sonnenfeld warns that what the market cheered Monday, Jensen Huang's White House–backed return as Nvidia's CEO and board member, could prove a giant mistake, exposing the directors to "historic" personal liability from a growing pile of lawsuits and raising the question of whether the country is celebrating a company that has helped put advanced chips in its adversaries' hands.

entry.title: The questions Jensen Huang and Nvidia will still have to answer about Megaspeed
entry.summary: The central question for investigators is what Nvidia knew about where those chips ended up and whether Huang's affair with a Megaspeed executive gave the company reason to doubt Megaspeed's assurances.

entry.title: Amazon and Meta reportedly in talks to lift blockade on AI agent Muse
entry.summary: Amazon and Meta are discussing a potential deal that would end a two-month-long blockade of Muse.

entry.title: AI data centers are becoming harder to build, and neoclouds are feeling it
entry.summary: ⁠Nvidia has made clear⁠ it won’t backstop an AI data center until it’s nearly ready to run, and that’s landing just as neoclouds report construction delays and more expensive debt. The message to developers is that land, power, and a finished building matter more than a pitch deck. ⁠Anita Verma-Lallian⁠ has been selling exactly that. […]

entry.title: Character.AI’s plan to auction off users’ private chats challenged by state AGs
entry.summary: The proposed Character.ai bankruptcy sale includes sensitive personal data from more than 21 million U.S. accounts, including 2.1 million registered to minors, the state AGs said.

entry.title: Want to buy your kid an AI toy this Christmas? Not in New York
entry.summary: New York has banned AI chatbot toys for five years as new research from Common Sense Media reveals troubling safety failures, including exposure to inappropriate content and risks to emotional development.

entry.title: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei calls accusations of surrendering human control to AI ‘absurd’
entry.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei pushes back against rivals’ accusations that he favors surrendering human agency to AI, even as leading AI companies increasingly automate their own research and model development.

entry.title: Jensen Huang broke Nvidia’s code of conduct, and his employees may not forget it
entry.summary: Most codes of conduct serve as a reflection of corporate culture. In Nvidia's case, that could have consequences.

entry.title: OpenAI says heavy ChatGPT users may hit limits sooner as it merges Chat and Work
entry.summary: OpenAI will introduce a single usage meter across ChatGPT as it combines the Chat and Work experiences.

entry.title: S&P considers Nvidia credit downgrade over governance and ‘key man’ risks
entry.summary: The credit rating agency may lower Nvidia's credit rating to AA-, the fourth-highest rating.

entry.title: Grand Theft Auto VI proves why efficiency isn’t a virtue
entry.summary: On the same day that Anthropic entered the public market, a painstakingly human video game became one of most successful entertainment launches of all time.

entry.title: Nvidia hits pause on chip shipments to Southeast Asia
entry.summary: Nvidia has told manufacturing partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia as the U.S. tightens its push to keep AI chips out of China.
